purpose: Mark the purpose or task for which something is useful or required.
keywords: Dictionary-form verb + のに + useful / necessary / time-cost expression.
This tool is useful for cutting vegetables.
It takes thirty minutes to get to the station.
A photograph is needed to apply.
formation: Dictionary-form verb + のに + useful / necessary / time-cost expression.
restrictions: The following predicate evaluates what is needed or useful for the activity.
mistake: This use does not mean although.
